subject: Run-of-show + rollback plan for renewal roadmap demo
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@healixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Run-of-show + rollback plan for renewal roadmap demo

Hi Lina —

Thanks again for agreeing to the renewal roadmap demo next week. To make the session smooth for your execs and engineers, I put together a concise run-of-show and a short rollback/fallback plan in case we hit any perf or access issues. Can you please confirm:

- That the 60-minute slot on Tue Oct 6 at 11:00 PT still works for your team?
- If recording is OK (we'll keep any PII redacted) — procurement asked for a copy for their review.
- Any special stakeholders we should prioritize (product, security, infra)?

Attached: run_of_show_v1.pdf (draft) — it includes a 5-min exec overview, 30-min demo with two breakpoints for Q&A, and a 20-min deep-dive for SRE questions. The rollback notes in SLA-fallback-notes.docx are marked for quick failover to a lightweight model and a hosted playback if live inference stalls.

Ops ask: Jonas is on standby as backup host. If Jonas needs to take over, we plan a 90-second handoff script included in the run-of-show. 

If you prefer a different sequencing (e.g., SRE first), say the word and we'll reorder.

Thanks — I can iterate quickly on the doc and lock the calendar once you confirm.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: run_of_show_v1.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
Attachment: SLA-fallback-notes.docx (DOCX, 45KB)

From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@healixhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@healixhealth.com
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Run-of-show + rollback plan for renewal roadmap demo

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks for the outline. Tuesday Oct 6 at 11:00 PT works for most of us, but two stakeholders have a conflict: our Head of Security can do 12:00 PT that day. Is there any way to shift 30 minutes later? If not, we can keep 11:00 and we’ll join for the deep-dive only.

Recording: procurement confirmed they'd like a copy for their audit trail. We need an explicit consent checkbox (we can sign a short form) before the recording starts.

Stakeholders: please expect product (Lina), security (Rajesh Kapoor), and procurement (procurement@healixhealth.com).

Quick note: can you include a 5-minute segment that covers data retention and KV cache eviction behavior? Security will ask.

Lina
Director, Product
Healix Health

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@healixhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Run-of-show + rollback plan for renewal roadmap demo

Quick ops update —

I reworked the run-of-show to shift the deep-dive earlier so security gets the 15-minute window at 12:00 PT if we move the call 30 minutes later. Changes in attached file: run_of_show_v1.pdf -> run_of_show_v2.pdf (minor reorder + explicit data-retention slide).

Key changes:
- Exec intro 0-5m
- Product demo 5-30m
- Security deep-dive (data retention, KV eviction, logs) 30-45m
- SRE deep-dive + Q&A 45-60m
- If we detect any latency > 800ms for p95 during demo, we trigger fallback: switch to cached-playback and spinner for 60s, then announce rollback to the alternate model. Rollback script is in SLA-fallback-notes.docx.

Ops needs:
- Moderator (Evelyn) confirm consent checkbox is in calendar invite (we need sign-off from procurement).
- Backup host (Jonas) will be on the Redwood call bridge: Host transfer script (90s) attached.

Attachment: run_of_show_v2.pdf (PDF, 140KB)
Attachment: SLA-fallback-notes.docx (DOCX, 47KB)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@healixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@healixhealth.com
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Run-of-show + rollback plan for renewal roadmap demo

Lina —

Thanks, that sequencing works. I’ve tentatively moved the meeting to Tue Oct 6 at 11:30 PT to accommodate your Head of Security. Calendar invite will show an explicit recording consent checkbox and a link to the short consent form (consent-checkbox.png) we’ll use at the start.

Confirming:
- Final run-of-show: run_of_show_v2.pdf (attached to internal thread)
- Rollback policy: SLA-fallback-notes.docx (we’ll run a single rehearsal on Monday at 10:00 PT to exercise the host handoff)
- Backup host: Jonas (will be muted unless takeover needed)
- Deliverable to procurement: recording + run-of-show + fallback notes after the session

I added the HubSpot deal link to the invite for your procurement team. If anyone on your side needs a different time, tell us by EOD Monday and we’ll accommodate.

Evelyn
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
